notes.title: Official Korean Language Patch
notes.notes:
Dear Nurse Love Addiction fans,

Thank you for all the support throughout the years. To make more people able to experience this title in their native language, we are happy to announce that we have added official Korean language support! 

We hope this can improve the overall experience, and if you have any suggestions on this update, please feel free to share them with us.

Cheers,

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR update, new DLC, sale and huge giveaway!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/b7058c944b684b73813de1139bf92ee9ae9a650e.png[/img]

First up, Hatsune Miku VR just got an update and new DLC bringing the total songs up to 19!

[h1]Update[/h1]
[list][*][b]Stage Select Screen[/b]
Added a costume and stick select (new Snow Miku & Negi available)
[*][b]Music Video mode[/b]
New song select screen: choose 8 songs to watch as a playlist with new costume select, stick select and stage select too.
[*][b]Sound enhancements[/b]
Rebalanced volume levels and changed in-game music to 3D sound.
[*][b]New free song[/b]
STELLA (by KotsubaneP)
[*][b]New free stage[/b]
Snow stage
[/list]

[h1]Sale[/h1]
And if that wasn't enough, we also have a sale on!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/707300/

[h1]Contest[/h1]
And to celebrate the update, DLC and launching on the Oculus store, we have a contest running on Gleam with prizes which include official Miku goodies, tickets to the Hatsune Miku Expo in Hong Kong in July and more!
Check the link below to enter:
https://gleam.io/bJt0s/hatsune-miku-vr-oculus-rift-experiences-launch

notes.title: Nurse Love Addiction Release Postponed to July 7th
notes.notes:
With a heavy heart we at Degica have decided to postpone the release of Nurse Love Addiction. 

During our final checks of the game, we felt certain elements of the game did not match the quality the release deserves or really show off what the story has to offer. As such we've postponed the release until July 7th, to make sure the game reaches you in its best possible state.

We at Degica Games are dedicated to releasing the best games we can, and while we understand that no one likes delays, we felt it preferable to releasing a game we were not proud of.
